highlights:
Czechia face Mexico at the FIFA World Cup 2026 in Group A on WED, JUN 24, kicking off at 21:00 local time. The match is played at Mexico City Stadium in Mexico City, Mexico. This preview covers the venue, predicted starting elevens, key players to watch and what's at stake for both sides.
[...]
## Predicted lineups and players to watch
[...]
Final squads for the 2026 World Cup are due to be announced by mid-May 2026, with each national federation submitting a 26-man list. The names below are current senior internationals expected to feature, based on recent international duty and Euro 2024 / Copa América 2024 squads. This is not the official squad — it will be updated when each federation publishes its final list.
[...]
### Czechia
[...]
Czechia — Coach: Ivan Hašek. Players to watch: Patrik Schick, Tomáš Souček. The official 26-man squad will be announced in late May 2026 ahead of the tournament.
[...]
Mexico — Coach: Javier Aguirre. Players to watch: Hirving Lozano, Edson Álvarez, Santiago Giménez. The official 26-man squad will be announced in late May 2026 ahead of the tournament.
